title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Matthew 3: John the Baptizer in the wilderness, his warning to the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the baptism of Jesus.

questions.text: What did John the Baptizer preach in the wilderness of Judea?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:1-2 says John the Baptizer came preaching in the wilderness of Judea: Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

answers.text: Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand
Follow me, and I will teach you

questions.text: Which prophet does the chapter say spoke of John?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:3 says this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet: the voice of one crying in the wilderness.
Matthew 3:4 says John wore clothing made of camel's hair with a leather belt, and his food was locusts and wild honey.

questions.text: Where were the people baptized, and what did they do there?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:6 says they were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

answers.text: In the Jordan, confessing their sins

questions.text: What did John call the Pharisees and Sadducees who came for his baptism?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:7 says he said to them: You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

questions.text: What did John say God is able to do with the stones?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:9 says they should not think to themselves that they have Abraham for their father, for God is able to raise up children to Abraham from those stones.

answers.text: Raise up children to Abraham from them

questions.text: What will the one with the winnowing fork do with the chaff?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:12 says he will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.

answers.text: Burn it up with unquenchable fire
Leave it on the threshing floor

questions.text: What did John say when Jesus came to be baptized by him?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:14 says John would have hindered him, saying: I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?

answers.text: Depart from me, for I am a sinner
Go, and I will follow after you
I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?

questions.text: As what did Jesus see the Spirit of God descending?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:16 says that when he was baptized the heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove and coming on him.

questions.text: What did the voice out of the heavens say?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:17 says a voice out of the heavens said: This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

answers.text: This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased
Hear him, all you nations of the earth
You are a prophet to the nations
